description_zh: 该接口用于为实例绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun rds add-tags-to-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddTagsToResource

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the generated token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the proxy mode
parameters.name: proxy_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can enter up to 30 instance IDs in a single request. If you enter more than one instance ID, you must separate the instance IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
支持传入最多30个实例ID进行批量操作，用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The tags that you want to add. Each tag consists of a tag key and a tag value. You can specify a maximum of five tags in the following format for each request: {"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"...}.

The tag key is required and the tag value is optional
parameters.help_zh:
需要绑定的Tag列表，包括TagKey和TagValue。单次最多支持传入5组值，格式：{"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"...}。
TagKey不能为空，TagValue可以为空
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The tag key of the first tag that you want to add. Each tag consists of a tag key and a tag value. You can specify up to five tags in a single request. You cannot specify an empty string as the tag key. You can specify an empty string as the tag value
parameters.help_zh: 当前第一组key。需要绑定的Tag，包括TagKey和TagValue，单次最多支持传入5组值。TagKey不能为空，TagValue可以为空
